title: Through a hole on a hill above Montignac, four friends found the painted cave of Lascaux

posts.facebook:
A hole in a hillside, a home-made lamp and a wall of painted horses. How Lascaux was found in September 1940.

How four friends found the Lascaux cave paintings in 1940, what the dog Robot did or did not do, why the cave was closed in 1963, and how you can see it today.

Some of the world's great finds were made by people who simply went and looked, then told someone who knew more.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/curious/lascaux-cave-discovery/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
